# Bagrat Motors

> Bagrat Motors is an umbrella roadside- and site-services company in Tbilisi, Georgia, operating 24/7. It provides three service lines: tow truck / evacuator, mobile tyre vulcanization, and mini-excavator work. Founder/director: Bagrat Giorgadze.

## Contact
- [Call 514 90 80 90](tel:+995514908090) — main line
- [WhatsApp](https://wa.me/995514908090)
- [Call 591 90 90 13](tel:+995591909013) — vulcanization line
- [Email info@bagratmotors.ge](mailto:info@bagratmotors.ge)
- Location: Tbilisi, Georgia. Hours: 24/7, every day.

## Main services
- [Towing / evacuator](https://bagratmotors.ge/en/services/towing/): tow-truck call-out, spider tow, accident & breakdown transport across Georgia, jump start, fuel delivery, lockout.
- [Mobile vulcanization](https://bagratmotors.ge/en/services/vulcanization/): on-site tyre repair, rim welding, rim straightening, battery replacement, jump start, lockout.
- [Mini-excavator](https://bagratmotors.ge/en/services/mini-excavator/): trench, foundation and utility-line digging, site levelling, demolition, landscaping in tight spaces.
